facts.fact: The finance and gender ministries confirmed in a joint notice that 15,825 old-age grants were suspended because beneficiary names were unverified in the National Population Registry System, so the grant beneficiary list is checked against the population registry.
A gender ministry spokesperson said the ministry is planning to incorporate its system with that of the Ministry of Home Affairs for improved reporting of deaths.
